candidates.observation: Pump plus drop is a normal fuel/dispensing convention; leak not established.
Broken/disconnected hose and escaped drop establish adverse fuel loss; first reading supports leak.
Horizontal pump body split can read gauge stripe; drop still resembles ordinary fueling.

familyFindings.constructionDiversity: Hose rupture, separated hose end and cracked reservoir are different mechanisms, although N52 and N54 do not make uncontrolled escape clear.
familyFindings.correction: N53 is viable as a working fuel-leak symbol. Keep the hose interruption obvious and drop displaced below it; do not turn it into a clean nozzle dispensing normally.
